n30562.title: Finite product formula
n30562.content:
\begin{lemma}[Finite product formula]
  \label{lem:finite_product_formula}
  \lean{Exchangeability.DeFinetti.ViaMartingale.finite_product_formula}
  \leanok
  \uses{lem:finite_level_factorization, lem:tail_factorization, lem:conditional_law_eq_directingMeasure}
  Under contractability, for every strictly monotone selection
  $k : \mathrm{Fin}\,m \to \mathbb{N}$ and any kernel $\nu$ satisfying the per-coordinate
  bridge \ref{lem:conditional_law_eq_directingMeasure}:
  \[
    \mathrm{Measure.map}\,(\omega \mapsto (i \mapsto X_{k\,i}(\omega)))\,\mu
      \,=\, \mu.\mathrm{bind}\,(\omega \mapsto \mathrm{Measure.pi}\,(\lambda\, i,\, \nu(\omega))).
  \]
  This is the martingale route's analogue of the L²/Koopman \ref{thm:condIndep_extension}:
  it bundles the rectangle $\pi$-system extension and the
  $\mathrm{Measure.map} = \mathrm{bind}$ identification into one step driven by
  per-coordinate conditional expectations.
\end{lemma}

n30599.name: Exchangeability.DeFinetti.L2Approach.l2_contractability_bound
n30599.type_full:
∀ {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  {n : Nat} (ξ : Fin n → Ω → Real) (m σ ρ : Real),
  And (LE.le (-1) ρ) (LE.le ρ 1) →
    (∀ (k : Fin n), Eq (MeasureTheory.integral μ fun ω => ξ k ω) m) →
      (∀ (k : Fin n), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun ω => HSub.hSub (ξ k ω) m) 2 μ) →
        (∀ (k : Fin n), Eq (MeasureTheory.integral μ fun ω => HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (ξ k ω) m) 2) (HPow.hPow σ 2)) →
          (∀ (i j : Fin n),
              Ne i j →
                Eq (MeasureTheory.integral μ fun ω => HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub (ξ i ω) m) (HSub.hSub (ξ j ω) m))
                  (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow σ 2) ρ)) →
            ∀ (p q : Fin n → Real),
              And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => p i) 1) (∀ (i : Fin n), LE.le 0 (p i)) →
                And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => q i) 1) (∀ (i : Fin n), LE.le 0 (q i)) →
                  LE.le
                    (MeasureTheory.integral μ fun ω =>
                      HPow.hPow
                        (HSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (p i) (ξ i ω))
                          (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (q i) (ξ i ω)))
                        2)
                    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul 2 (HPow.hPow σ 2)) (HSub.hSub 1 ρ))
                      (iSup fun i => abs (HSub.hSub (p i) (q i))))

n30623.name: Exchangeability.DeFinetti.ViaL2.weighted_sums_converge_L1
n30623.type_full:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (X : Nat → Ω → Real),
  Exchangeability.Contractable μ X →
    (∀ (i : Nat), Measurable (X i)) →
      (∀ (i : Nat), MeasureTheory.MemLp (X i) 2 μ) →
        ∀ (f : Real → Real),
          Measurable f →
            (Exists fun M => ∀ (x : Real), LE.le (abs (f x)) M) →
              Exists fun alpha =>
                And (Measurable alpha)
                  (And (MeasureTheory.MemLp alpha 1 μ)
                    (∀ (n : Nat) (ε : Real),
                      GT.gt ε 0 →
                        Exists fun M =>
                          ∀ (m : Nat),
                            GE.ge m M →
                              LT.lt
                                (MeasureTheory.integral μ fun ω =>
                                  abs
                                    (HSub.hSub
                                      (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv 1 ↑m)
                                        (Finset.univ.sum fun k => f (X (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd n ↑k) 1) ω)))
                                      (alpha ω)))
                                ε))

                (MeasureTheory.condExp (Exchangeability.DeFinetti.ViaMartingale.futureFiltration X m) μ
                  (Exchangeability.DeFinetti.ViaMartingale.indProd X r C))
                fun ω =>

                (MeasureTheory.ae μ)) →

n30638.name: Exchangeability.DeFinetti.ViaMartingale.condExp_indicator_eq_of_contractable

  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Nat → Ω → α},
  Exchangeability.Contractable μ X →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Measurable (X n)) →
      ∀ {r m : Nat},

            MeasurableSet A →
              have U := fun ω i => X (↑i) ω;
              have W := Exchangeability.DeFinetti.ViaMartingale.shiftRV X (HAdd.hAdd m 1);
              have W' := Exchangeability.DeFinetti.ViaMartingale.consRV (fun ω => X r ω) W;
              (MeasureTheory.ae μ).EventuallyEq
                (MeasureTheory.condExp (MeasurableSpace.comap W' inferInstance) μ
                  ((Set.preimage U A).indicator fun x => 1))
                (MeasureTheory.condExp (MeasurableSpace.comap W inferInstance) μ
                  ((Set.preimage U A).indicator fun x => 1))
